name: scrcpy
description:
scrcpy is an open-source utility that displays and controls Android devices connected via USB or over Wi-Fi. It requires no root access on the device and delivers ultra-low latency mirroring.

Features:
- High performance mirroring at 30 to 120 FPS with minimal latency (35-70 ms)
- Full mouse, touchpad, and physical keyboard control forwarding
- Audio forwarding from Android 11+ devices directly to your PC speakers
- Bidirectional clipboard synchronization, file drag-and-drop, and APK installation
- High visual quality with configurable bitrates, resolutions, and video recording
